title: A jet above water
hook: A fish can act on something outside the water.

knows: Different fish can have different structures and behaviors.
doesNotKnow: The schematic jet runs from the fish toward the insect above the water. Archerfishes can shoot water at prey on vegetation; this drawing exaggerates the path and does not predict accuracy, distance or a particular outcome.

misconception: The first imagined explanation must apply to this fish.
objective: How can an archerfish dislodge an insect on vegetation above the surface?

claims.text: A fish can act on something outside the water. How can an archerfish dislodge an insect on vegetation above the surface? The schematic jet runs from the fish toward the insect above the water. Archerfishes can shoot water at prey on vegetation; this drawing exaggerates the path and does not predict accuracy, distance or a particular outcome. Insect above water, Water jet
